title: Battery Safety Risk Assessment
description: Assesses safety risks for battery/electrochemical samples: thermal runaway, electrolyte handling, voltage/overcharge, and storage hazards.

steps.prompt: Based on the sample data and experimental context, assess the thermal runaway risk. Consider battery chemistry, electrode materials, electrolyte composition, and any prior thermal events. Rate the risk from 1 (low) to 5 (high) and list concrete mitigations.
Evaluate electrolyte handling risks, including chemical toxicity, flammability, volatility, and safe disposal. Rate from 1 to 5 and provide specific handling and storage mitigations.
Assess voltage and overcharge risks for this sample/cell. Consider maximum safe voltage, BMS requirements, short-circuit potential, and overcharge failure modes. Rate from 1 to 5 with mitigations.

Evaluate storage and transport safety risks: temperature requirements, state of charge for storage, incompatible materials, shelf life concerns, and labeling requirements. Rate from 1 to 5 with mitigations.
